fullContentHtml:
CGPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) has released the admit card for the post of Assistant District Public Prosecution Officer (ADPO). This recruitment was released for 15 posts. The online application process for CGPSC ADPO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 22 June 2026, to 21 July 2026. The Exam is going to conducted on 20 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for CGPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 June 2026
  • Last Date : 21 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 22-24 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 20 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, OBC (NCL) : Rs. 300/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

CGPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 21 July 2026.

The official website is: https://psc.cg.gov.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
